from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now=datetime.now()
print('now', now)
# compute last Tuesday (weekday: Monday=0 ... Sunday=6)
# assume 'last Tuesday' means previous occurrence strictly before today if today is Tuesday? unclear. We'll interpret as the most recent Tuesday prior to today (not including today).
# If today is Tuesday, then last Tuesday is 7 days ago.
target_weekday=1 # Tuesday
days_ago=(now.weekday()-target_weekday)%7
if days_ago==0:
    days_ago=7
last_tuesday=now-timedelta(days=days_ago)
print('days_ago', days_ago, 'last_tuesday', last_tuesday.date())
print('last_tuesday_iso', last_tuesday.date().isoformat())
